title: Companion mediation prompts ('call it a draw', 'not yours to grade') that are explicitly framed as the safe/neutral choice actually carry real fail chance and, on failure, cost regard with BOTH companions at once — worse than just picking a side. The framing undersells the risk.
where: various companion dispute dialogues (Lys/Tamsin, Osk/Tamsin, Osk/Vell)
